name: Roboto Mono
scope: Workspace UI font for the C++/Qt entry, loaded privately per process. It is not the terminal grid font and not a claim of WindTerm font parity.

upstream.note: The unmodified static Regular font and the same-commit license are kept as the upstream original bytes. No subsetting, conversion or renaming is applied.

deployment.note: Product staging requires the pinned font and license, verifies the build copy is byte-identical to this source tree, and also carries README.md as provenance documentation.
